newsitem.title: USA: Cedyco acquires LL&E No. 1 Lease.
newsitem.headline: Cedyco acquires LL&E No. 1 Lease.

text.p: Cedyco Corp said it acquired the LL&E No. 1 Lease, covering the Manilla Village Field in Jefferson Parish, La., from a privately owned company for an undisclosed amount of stock and cash.

Cedyco will test this well in the "Q" sand formation, at about the 16,000 foot interval in the next 30 days. Results of this test may be available as early as January 3, stated Christina Dreyer, vice president of Cedyco.

"Cedyco can now aggressively develop its interest in the Manilla Village Field," she said. "The acquisition of the LL&E No. 1 in conjunction with Cedyco's other interests in the surrounding producing properties places Cedyco in an excellent position to take advantage of the Manilla Village Field and its tremendous potential."

Natural gas prices in the Manilla Village Field are averaging about $3.57 per thousand cubic feet with oil averaging an about $22.00 per barrel, according to the Natural Gas Clearinghouse, Cedyco pointed out.
